parts.label: a
parts.technique: Calculating Sxy and Sxx for regression
parts.reason: These sums are computed specifically to set up the regression line calculation; explicit exclusion S2.2 rules out calculations involving regression lines, and this part feeds directly into that.

parts.label: b
parts.reason: Explicit exclusion S2.2: calculations involving regression lines are excluded.

parts.label: c
parts.technique: Using regression line to estimate value
parts.reason: Uses the excluded regression line calculation from (b); regression line calculations excluded per S2.2.

parts.label: d
parts.technique: Converting coded regression line back to original variables
parts.reason: Still a regression line calculation, excluded by S2.2.

parts.label: e
parts.reason: Regression line calculation, excluded by S2.2.

parts.label: f
parts.reason: Depends entirely on the excluded regression-line estimate from (e); part only makes sense after an out-of-spec part.

parts.label: a
parts.technique: E(X) and Var(X) of discrete uniform distribution
parts.reason: S4.1 explicitly excludes calculation of mean and variance of discrete random variables.

parts.label: b
parts.reason: Depends on E(X) from excluded part (a); general discrete random variable E(X) manipulation is excluded.

parts.label: c
parts.reason: Depends on excluded Var(X) calculation from (a).
